title: India just crossed 164 gigawatts of solar power
sources: SolarQuarter - India's solar capacity surpasses 164 GW
BioEnergy Times - India's solar capacity surges to 162.15 GW
caption:
India just crossed 164 gigawatts of solar power. That's the world's third-largest installed solar capacity.

India's installed solar capacity crossed 164.59 GW by July 2026, per MNRE data. A separate government reply to Parliament citing IRENA's 2026 statistics places India third globally - a nearly 57-fold increase since 2014.

A decade ago, India's solar capacity barely registered globally. Now it's the third-largest in the world and still climbing.

Sources: SolarQuarter, BioEnergy Times (2026)
